# Dekho Hatke
> Automation, coding, tools and code you can actually use

- [Automate Your Daily Tasks with Python](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/automate-daily-tasks-python/): Rename files, clean folders and send reports automatically with a short Python script.
- [Schedule Python Scripts with Cron and Render](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/schedule-python-scripts-render/): Run your scripts on a timer using cron locally or a free Render web service kept awake by a pinger.
- [Build a Telegram Bot That Reports to You](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/telegram-bot-report-python/): Send yourself automation results and alerts through a simple Telegram bot.
- [Flutter Setup and Your First App](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/flutter-setup-first-app/): Install Flutter, create a project and run it on an emulator or a real phone.
- [Flutter State Management Basics](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/flutter-state-management-basics/): Understand setState, when it is enough and when to move to a state-management package.
- [C++ Pointers Explained Simply](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/cpp-pointers-explained/): A pointer is just an address. Learn declaring, dereferencing and avoiding common mistakes.
- [JavaScript Fetch API: A Practical Guide](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/javascript-fetch-api-guide/): Call your own backend from a static website, handle errors and avoid CORS surprises.
- [Android Java: RecyclerView Step by Step](https://dekhohatke.com/blog/android-java-recyclerview/): Show a fast scrolling list in an Android app using RecyclerView and an adapter.
